title: Document Metadata Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating document frontmatter metadata in the finance project

owner.description: The owner or maintainer of the document

area.description: The area or domain the document belongs to (e.g., 'finance', 'common', 'client')

topic.description: The specific topic or subject of the document

last-updated.description: The date when the document was last updated (ISO 8601 date format: YYYY-MM-DD)

related-code-paths.description: List of related code paths or file references
